title: A bomb arrow costs no bomb
description: From a ledge, the player presses the bomb key with a bow barely drawn, and nothing happens: he shoots a plain arrow. Drawn all the way, the key makes a bomb arrow, which sticks in a wall and blows up there, while his bombs stay at four.
